verdict.rationale: MoonPay is a crypto payments and ramp platform, so agent-initiated stablecoin payments are a fair axis to judge it on. The evidence pack documents no agent payment flow with human-configured spend controls or scoped authority. The documented MCP server only lets agents search and retrieve documentation, and forwarding a customer accessToken to a backend is a generic developer building block, not scoped agent spending authority.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can move stablecoins under scoped authority — documented agent payment flows where an agent initiates a payment or payout with spend controls a human configured
